(1) entity  entity instance

     Entity ER
`'(An entity is a collection of distinguishable real-world objects with common
properties.)

     Entity instance ER
`'(An entity instance corresponds to one of the distinguishable real-world
objects that make up the entity.)

(5) relationship  relationship instance

     Given an ordered list of m entities E1,E2,...,Em (where the same entity may occur more than once in
the list), a relationship R defines a rule of correspondence between the instances of these entities.

     a relationship instance or a relationship occurrence is a particular occurrence of a relationship,
corresponding to a m-tuple of entity occurrences (e1,e2,...,em), where ei is an instance of Ei in the
relationship.

(8) single-valued participation  multi-valued participation
    Ø if max_card(E,R) = 1 then E is said to have single-valued participation ()
       in the relationship R.
    Ø If max_card(E,R) = N, then E is said to be multi-valued participation () in
       this relationship.

(9) mandatory participation  optional participation
    Ø If min_card(E,R) = 1, E is said to have mandatory participation () in the
       relationship R
    Ø if min_card(E,R) = 0, then E is said to be optional participation (
       ) in this relationship.
